references.text: The Akrabbim Pass is mentioned as a boundary marker for the land of Israel, the same place as in Judges 1:36
The ascent of Akrabbim is mentioned as part of Judah's southern border, overlapping with the territory of the Amorites
Sela (the rock/mountain) is mentioned in connection with Edom, the same geographical area as the Amorite border
Sela is mentioned as a place in the same region south of the Dead Sea
